integrity: The universal claim is supported by case-by-case rank identities, finite lattice counting by formula, and a deterministic coupling, not by numerical extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Exact capture times proved off the integer grid only; grid-line orbits and other center/angle configurations not classified. An inaccessible general 2003 source leaves a publication-priority risk. Finite checker runs are only cross-checks of the independent algebraic proof.
title: Exact capture-time shells and triangular large-window law for a non-bijective quarter-turn map
